title: AudioFile
description: Music tracks and sound cues (architecture section 4, design doc 13.6). A cue is a short recipe for the Web Audio API, so effects need no files; `content/feedback.json` says which event plays which cue. Cross-checks (cue references, track files) are in app/audio.ts and tools/check-audio.ts.

scenes.description: Scene key to track id, for the scenes that are not a chapter's rooms.

chapters.description: Chapter id to track id, for the rooms of that chapter.

boss.description: Track id while a boss is fighting, over the chapter's own.

sourceUrl.description: Where the original was downloaded; tools/audio/build-music.ts reads the original's file name from it.

trimDb.description: Level correction in dB, measured so every cue peaks alike (200 ms RMS); see docs/audio/cues.md.

semitoneBy.description: Name of an event field: the cue rises one semitone for each unit of it (the combo step of a stationery sound).

caption.description: Key into content/strings: the bracketed caption shown when captions are on.

minGapMs.description: The same cue is not started again within this many milliseconds. 30 when absent.

wave.description: Oscillator shape of a tone; sine when absent.

freq.description: A tone's start frequency in Hz.

to.description: A tone's end frequency, reached by an exponential glide over its length.

filter.description: Filter of a noise; lowpass when absent.

cutoff.description: A noise's filter frequency in Hz.

cutoffTo.description: The filter frequency a noise glides to.

at.description: Seconds after the cue starts; 0 when absent.
